items.problem: After swapping a deferred hero CaptureElement to the recommended Border placeholder, the build failed with CS1061 'Border does not contain a definition for Source' because the code-behind still drove the old control (PreviewControl.Source = mediaCapture / null, .FlowDirection).
items.evidence: session-log.txt turns 46-47: 'CS1061: Border does not contain a definition for Source' (OcrCapturedImage.xaml.cs 415,483); agent replaced .Source assignments with Visibility toggling.
items.covered_at: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md, section 'CS0246 / WMC0001: CaptureElement could not be found' (lines 53-75) — recommends swapping the hero surface to a visible Border placeholder.
items.proposed_improvement: Add one sentence to that existing section noting that after the XAML swap the code-behind that drove the original control (`.Source`, preview Start/Stop, `.FlowDirection`, transport-control wiring) must also be removed/neutralized, since those members do not exist on the Border placeholder and will not compile.
items.generalizes: The XAML-swap-to-placeholder pattern applies to any deferred hero surface (CaptureElement, InkCanvas, MapControl). Every one has code-behind that manipulates the original control, so the same CS1061 cascade recurs unless the doc reminds the agent to clean up the code-behind.
